# device42_room (Resource)


## Exemple 

```hcl
resource "device42_room" "myNewRoom" {
    name          = "myNewRoom"
    building_id   = 1
    notes         = "Main server room"
    tags          = "Prod,East"
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the room. ForceNew.

### Optional

- `building` (String) Name of the building that contains this room (alternative to building_id).
- `building_id` (Number) ID of the building that contains this room.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Any custom fields that will be used in device42.
- `horizontal_grid_numbering` (String) Horizontal grid numbering: Numeric, Alphabetic or Alphabetic_doubled.
- `horizontal_grid_start` (String) Horizontal grid start value.
- `notes` (String) Any additional notes.
- `reverse_xaxis` (String) Reverse x-axis numbering (yes/no).
- `reverse_yaxis` (String) Reverse y-axis numbering (yes/no).
- `tags` (String) Add or update tags to a room (comma separated).
- `vertical_grid_numbering` (String) Vertical grid numbering: Numeric, Alphabetic or Alphabetic_doubled.
- `vertical_grid_start` (String) Vertical grid start value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `grid_cols` (Number) Number of columns in the room grid.
- `grid_rows` (Number) Number of rows in the room grid.
- `room_id` (Number) ID of the room.

### Import

Room resources can be imported using the room name, e.g.

```bash
$ terraform import device42_room.myNewRoom myNewRoom
```
